desc: Derive the exact count and cost formulas for marginal terms \((2j-1)P_i\) below or at a threshold.
Implement an overflow-safe \(O(N\log V)\) feasibility check for a candidate threshold, including duplicate marginal-cost handling.
Establish safe binary-search bounds for the maximum threshold.
Implement the complete stdin/stdout Python solution with efficient integer arithmetic.
Verify conceptually on both samples and edge cases such as \(N=1\), \(M=1\), and equal \(P_i\).
